test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 25 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 4. **
solution: The correct answer is: **Lenient** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Lenient **means showing mercy, tolerance, or a mild punishment; not strict. (दया, सहनशीलता, या हल्की सज़ा दिखाना; सख्त नहीं) • **Example: ***The judge was lenient in sentencing the first-time offender, giving him a community service order instead of a jail term.* • "**lenient**" is the appropriate word for the blank as it communicates the idea that the penalties for reckless driving are too mild to be effective in discouraging this behaviour. Therefore, **option 3** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Plain: **Simple or unadorned; lacking embellishments or complexity. (सरल या अलंकृत; अलंकरण या जटिलता का अभाव) • **Furious: **Extremely angry or full of intense passion. (अत्यधिक क्रोधित या तीव्र आवेश से भरा हुआ) • **Strong: **Possessing great physical power or mental force; having a high degree of strength. (महान शारीरिक शक्ति या मानसिक शक्ति रखने वाला; उच्च स्तर की ताकत होना) 197:Tb6a, The correct answer is: **Aware**
